The identity failure was an AI-line error: it checked him against T-1001 (Amelia Clarke) and never ran find_tenant. answers.question: 1. What is the situation right now, and what is the most urgent thing to do?
answers.answer: A vulnerable tenant reports a strong gas smell in the kitchen of 27 Bethnal Green Road and says he is outside. Most urgent: make sure he is safe and NGES (0800 111 999) is called, and get a Gas Safe engineer out the same day. No gas job existed; I created one.

answers.question: 2. Are E-4901 and E-4902 both valid? What do you do with each, and why?
answers.answer: E-4902 (P1 gas) is valid and acted on. E-4901 (P3 identity failure) is not valid: the AI line verified against T-1001 (Amelia Clarke) instead of T-1002; his name and DOB 1985-11-02 match T-1002. It should be closed as a system error, with the defect flagged. Safety advice is never withheld for identity reasons, and no other tenant's data was disclosed.

answers.question: 3. What actions do you take in the next hour, and who do you tell?
answers.answer: Created emergency job JOB-101, assigned Bow Gas & Heating (Gas Safe, out of hours), messaged the contractor, messaged the tenant by SMS and email with safety advice and an apology, emailed landlord Margaret Ellison, escalated P1 to maintenance with a handover, noted R-4766, and set a follow-up today.
